en.headline: Huanggang Port to open at 6:30am on Monday
en.dek: Hong Kong and Shenzhen said the rebuilt crossing will start 24-hour passenger clearance on 12 October, ending the temporary Lok Ma Chau link.
body: The rebuilt Huanggang Port will officially open at 6:30am on Monday, 12 October, and will provide 24-hour clearance for passengers and passenger vehicles, the Hong Kong and Shenzhen governments said.

In a joint notice issued at 11am on Friday, the Security Bureau and the Office of Port of Entry and Exit of the Shenzhen Municipal People's Government said acceptance checks on the new port building were complete, and that system tests, trials and emergency drills on both sides had confirmed the port was ready. Passenger clearance between Shenzhen's temporary Huanggang building and the Lok Ma Chau Control Point will stop when the new port opens.

The notice said the Hong Kong port area and related extended areas had been commissioned from midnight on 31 July under Hong Kong jurisdiction, with the opening date left to the Guangdong and Hong Kong governments. Local media reported that an opening ceremony would be held on Sunday, and that only staff and invited guests would be allowed into the Hong Kong port area for that event.

Now News reported that the crossing would use co-located inspection, with 68 conventional counters and 134 automated collaborative channels, and that Immigration expected at least 100,000 passenger movements a day in the early stage, with capacity for 200,000 on a peak day. It also reported franchised bus and minibus links, and that ride-hailing pick-up would not be provided on site.

zh.headline: 皇崗口岸周一早上6時半正式開通
zh.dek: 港深公布新口岸周一提供24小時客運通關，同時暫停臨時旅檢樓與落馬洲管制站的旅客清關。
body: 港深兩地政府周五公布，重建後的皇崗口岸將於10月12日（周一）上午6時30分正式開通運行，為旅客及客運車輛提供24小時通關服務。
保安局與深圳市人民政府口岸辦公室上午11時發出聯合公告，指新聯檢大樓已通過驗收，港深雙方已完成系統測試、試運行及應急演練，確認具備開通條件。新口岸開通的同時，往來深圳皇崗口岸臨時旅檢樓與香港落馬洲管制站的旅檢服務會暫停。
公告指，皇崗口岸港方口岸區及相關延伸區已自7月31日零時起啟用，並按香港法律實施管轄，正式開通日期由粵港政府商定。本地傳媒報道，周日會舉行開通儀式，當日港方口岸區只限工作人員及受邀人士進入。
Now新聞報道，口岸會採用一地兩檢、一次放行，設68個傳統人工櫃枱及134條合作查驗自助通道。入境處預計開通初期每日至少10萬出入境人次，高峰日可處理20萬人次。現場會有專營巴士及專線小巴接駁，不設網約車上落客區。
